title: Sliding Mode Controller (Reaching Law)
text: 基于趋近律设计滑模控制器，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；按 {Reaching Rate (Eta)} 指定趋近速率；{Task Mode} 指定模块运行模式 Regulation、{Sliding Coefficient Matrix (C)} 指定滑动系数矩阵、{Use externally sourced derivative} 指定从外部指定状态参考的导数、{Output Switching Function} 输出切换函数、{Reaching Law} 指定趋近律 Constant、{Control Gain (K)} 控制增益、{Power Rate Exponent (Alpha)} 指定幂次趋近律指数、{Select Boundary Layer} 指定边界层函数、{Enable zero-crossing detection} 启用过零检测、{Phi} 指定边界层厚度，按实例取值。

ports.name: x.ref.dot
ports.summary: 状态参考轨迹的导数 vector

params.name: Task Mode
params.values: 模块运行模式 Regulation Mode (default) | Tracking Mode

params.name: Sliding Coefficient Matrix (C)
params.values: 滑动系数矩阵 1 (default) | scalar | column vector | matrix

params.name: Use externally sourced derivative
params.values: 从外部指定状态参考的导数 off (default) | on

params.name: Output Switching Function
params.values: 输出切换函数 off (default) | on

params.name: Reaching Law
params.values: 趋近律 Constant Rate (default) | Exponential | Power Rate

params.name: Reaching Rate (Eta)
params.values: 趋近速率 0.01 (default) | positive scalar | column vector

params.name: Control Gain (K)
params.values: 控制增益 0.01 (default) | positive scalar | column vector

params.name: Power Rate Exponent (Alpha)
params.values: 幂次趋近律指数 0.01 (default) | positive scalar between 0 and 1 | column vector of positive values between 0 and 1

params.name: Select Boundary Layer
params.values: 边界层函数 Sign (default) | Relay | Hyperbolic Tangent | Saturation

params.name: Enable zero-crossing detection
params.values: 启用过零检测 off (default) | on

params.name: Phi
params.values: 边界层厚度 0.01 (default) | positive scalar | column vector
